published_source: Printed Table 7, column (3) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2020.3626.pdf), read Nov 4 2026
table_note: published article numbering (Nov 4 2026); the authors' do-file block is 5, which earlier records used
replication_status: exact (authors' Stata do-file estimate.do line 70 rerun on the shipped firmpanel.dta, reghdfe keepsing with gvkey_num + state_year FE: 0.016252 (0.004359), N 19,096; printed Table 7, column (3) [the do-file's Table 5 column 3, the spec's table field]: 0.016 (0.004), N 19,096)
notes: reghdfe ln_top5 law, a(gvkey_num state_year) vce(cluster incorp_hist_id). Modal-state TWFE (fixest): 0.015569 (0.004160) vs authors' 0.016252 (0.004359). DEVIATION: authors absorb gvkey_num + state_year, where state_year = group(state_hist, fyear) is the firm's (time-varying) headquarters state x year. state_year was decoded exactly into 40 HQ states (egen-group ordering; fixest with gvkey_num + hq_state^fyear reproduces the authors' coefficient exactly). 82/942 firms (8.7%) change HQ state; 371/19,096 firm-years (1.94%) are outside the firm's modal state. Hull allows only time-invariant group-by-time FE, so xt_vars uses the firm's MODAL HQ state (hq_modal_chr, character so that did/didimputation treat it as categorical). Data file: firmpanel_hq.rds in _work (ignore firmpanel_aug.rds).
